#| label: build-remaining-manuscript-figures
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

repo_root <- function() {
  root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))) {
    abort("Run this script from the phage_uv_ecology_analysis repository root")
  }
  root
}

deterministic_context <- function(x, maximum = 20000L) {
  if (!nrow(x)) return(x)
  index <- unique(round(seq(1, nrow(x), length.out = min(maximum, nrow(x)))))
  x[index]
}

promote_file <- function(source, destination) {
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  incoming <- paste0(destination, ".incoming-", Sys.getpid())
  if (!file.copy(source, incoming, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE)) {
    abort("Failed to stage %s for promotion", basename(destination))
  }
  if (!file.rename(incoming, destination)) {
    unlink(incoming)
    abort("Failed to promote %s", basename(destination))
  }
}

sample_levels <- c(
  "C I1", "C I2", "C I3", "C BF1", "C BF2", "C BF3",
  "P I1", "P I2", "P I3", "P BF1", "P BF2", "P BF3"
)

coefficient_labels <- c(
  condition_adjusted = "Adjusted condition",
  cycle2_interaction = "Cycle 2 interaction",
  cycle3_interaction = "Cycle 3 interaction",
  condition_cycle_omnibus = "Interaction omnibus"
)

make_pair_matrix <- function(pair_data, mag_id, panel_label, selected_samples = sample_levels) {
  x <- pair_data[MAG_ID == mag_id & pair_passes_qc == TRUE]
  x[, `:=`(
    sample_a_label = factor(sample_label_a, levels = selected_samples),
    sample_b_label = factor(sample_label_b, levels = selected_samples)
  )]
  x <- x[!is.na(sample_a_label) & !is.na(sample_b_label)]
  symmetric <- rbindlist(list(
    x[, .(
      sample_y = as.character(sample_a_label),
      sample_x = as.character(sample_b_label),
      consensus_differences_per_mbp
    )],
    x[, .(
      sample_y = as.character(sample_b_label),
      sample_x = as.character(sample_a_label),
      consensus_differences_per_mbp
    )]
  ))
  grid <- CJ(sample_y = selected_samples, sample_x = selected_samples, unique = TRUE)
  grid <- symmetric[grid, on = c("sample_y", "sample_x")]
  grid[, `:=`(
    sample_y = factor(sample_y, levels = rev(selected_samples)),
    sample_x = factor(sample_x, levels = selected_samples),
    panel_label = panel_label,
    diagonal = as.character(sample_y) == as.character(sample_x)
  )]
  grid
}

write_remaining_outputs <- function(root, output_dir) {
  project_data <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
  de_root <- file.path(project_data, "derived", "full_transcriptome_de")
  interpretation_root <- file.path(project_data, "derived", "full_de_interpretation")
  population_root <- file.path(project_data, "derived", "manuscript_candidates")

  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) abort("Candidate output directory does not exist: %s", output_dir)
  existing_main <- file.path(output_dir, "figures", c(
    "global-transcriptome-structure.pdf",
    "functional-organism-restructuring.pdf",
    "recurrent-gene-structure.pdf"
  ))
  if (any(!file.exists(existing_main))) {
    abort("Build the first three candidates before running the remaining-figure builder")
  }

  source(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))

  paths <- list(
    filtering = file.path(de_root, "tables", "filtering_summary.tsv"),
    libraries = file.path(de_root, "tables", "library_sizes_and_normalization.tsv"),
    diagnostics = file.path(de_root, "tables", "model_fit_diagnostics.tsv"),
    interaction = file.path(de_root, "tables", "de_condition_cycle_interaction_coefficients.tsv"),
    omnibus = file.path(de_root, "tables", "de_condition_cycle_interaction_omnibus.tsv"),
    functional = file.path(interpretation_root, "tables", "functional_category_enrichment.tsv"),
    mag = file.path(interpretation_root, "tables", "mag_coherence.tsv"),
    clusters = file.path(population_root, "tables", "mag_genomic_variation_strain_clusters.tsv"),
    pair_qc = file.path(population_root, "tables", "population_genomics_pair_qc.tsv"),
    mag_qc = file.path(population_root, "tables", "population_genomics_mag_qc.tsv")
  )
  missing <- names(paths)[!file.exists(unlist(paths))]
  if (length(missing)) abort("Missing inputs: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  staging <- file.path(dirname(output_dir), sprintf(".remaining-figure-staging-%d", Sys.getpid()))
  if (dir.exists(staging)) unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(file.path(staging, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(staging, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  on.exit(unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  condition_values <- c(
    Control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
    `Phage-UV` = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]],
    control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
    treatment = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]]
  )

  # Main candidate: coverage-qualified population-genomic heterogeneity.
  clusters <- fread(paths$clusters)
  clusters[, sample_label := factor(sample_label, levels = sample_levels)]
  cluster_mag_order <- c(
    "TI3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000001",
    "CBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000031",
    "TBF2_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000085",
    "CBF2_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000015",
    "TBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000022"
  )
  cluster_labels <- clusters[, .(panel_label = first(panel_label)), by = MAG_ID]
  cluster_labels[, display_order := match(MAG_ID, cluster_mag_order)]
  setorder(cluster_labels, display_order)
  panel_levels <- cluster_labels$panel_label

  cluster_grid <- CJ(
    panel_label = panel_levels,
    sample_label = sample_levels,
    unique = TRUE
  )
  cluster_grid <- clusters[, .(panel_label, sample_label, condition, strain_cluster)][
    cluster_grid,
    on = c("panel_label", "sample_label")
  ]
  cluster_grid[, `:=`(
    panel_label = factor(panel_label, levels = rev(panel_levels)),
    sample_label = factor(sample_label, levels = sample_levels),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("control", "treatment"))
  )]

  p_clusters <- ggplot(cluster_grid, aes(sample_label, panel_label)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = condition), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_text(aes(label = strain_cluster), size = 2.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = condition_values[c("control", "treatment")],
      labels = c(control = "Control", treatment = "Phage-UV"),
      na.value = "#EFEFEF",
      na.translate = FALSE,
      name = "Membrane"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "A") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 38, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  mag_qc <- fread(paths$mag_qc)[eligible_for_descriptive_panel == TRUE]
  mag_qc <- merge(mag_qc, cluster_labels[, .(MAG_ID, panel_label)], by = "MAG_ID", all.x = TRUE)
  mag_qc[, phylum_group := fifelse(
    is.na(phylum) | !nzchar(phylum),
    "Unclassified",
    fifelse(phylum %chin% names(phage_uv_phylum_colours), phylum, "Other")
  )]
  mag_qc[, panel_label := factor(panel_label, levels = rev(panel_levels))]
  phylum_values <- phage_uv_phylum_colours[unique(mag_qc$phylum_group)]

  p_mag_qc <- ggplot(
    mag_qc,
    aes(
      median_consensus_differences_per_mbp,
      panel_label,
      xmin = minimum_consensus_differences_per_mbp,
      xmax = maximum_consensus_differences_per_mbp,
      colour = phylum_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", width = 0, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(aes(size = observed_samples), shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_values, name = "Phylum") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.3, 4.2), breaks = c(6, 8, 10), name = "Observed samples") +
    labs(x = "Consensus differences per callable Mbp", y = NULL, tag = "B") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  pair_qc <- fread(paths$pair_qc)
  label_lookup <- unique(clusters[, .(sample_id, sample_label = as.character(sample_label))])
  pair_qc <- label_lookup[pair_qc, on = c(sample_id = "sample_a")]
  setnames(pair_qc, "sample_label", "sample_label_a")
  pair_qc <- label_lookup[pair_qc, on = c(sample_id = "sample_b")]
  setnames(pair_qc, "sample_label", "sample_label_b")

  target_mag <- "TI3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000001"
  target_label <- cluster_labels[MAG_ID == target_mag, panel_label]
  target_samples <- clusters[MAG_ID == target_mag, as.character(sample_label)]
  target_samples <- sample_levels[sample_levels %chin% target_samples]
  target_matrix <- make_pair_matrix(pair_qc, target_mag, target_label, target_samples)

  p_target <- ggplot(target_matrix, aes(sample_x, sample_y)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = consensus_differences_per_mbp), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_tile(data = target_matrix[diagonal == TRUE], fill = "white", colour = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#084594"),
      trans = "log10",
      na.value = "#EAEAEA",
      name = "Consensus differences\nper callable Mbp"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "C") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.2) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 38, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  population_main <- p_clusters / (p_mag_qc | p_target) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.92, 1.18), widths = c(1.08, 1))
  population_main_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "population-genomic-heterogeneity.pdf")
  ggsave(population_main_path, population_main, width = 11, height = 8.3, device = grDevices::pdf)

  fwrite(cluster_grid, file.path(staging, "tables", "population_genomics_cluster_panel.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(mag_qc, file.path(staging, "tables", "population_genomics_summary_panel.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(target_matrix, file.path(staging, "tables", "population_genomics_propionicimonas_panel.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  # Supplementary model and library diagnostics.
  filtering <- fread(paths$filtering)
  filter_panel <- data.table(
    stage = factor(c("Input", "Retained"), levels = c("Retained", "Input")),
    features = c(filtering$input_features, filtering$retained_features)
  )
  p_filter <- ggplot(filter_panel, aes(features, stage)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.58, fill = "#777777", colour = "#222222", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = format(features, big.mark = ",")),
      hjust = -0.08,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    labs(x = "Features", y = NULL, tag = "A") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

  libraries <- fread(paths$libraries)
  libraries[, sample_short := factor(
    paste0(
      fifelse(condition == "control", "C ", "P "),
      fifelse(phase == "initial", "I", "BF"),
      cycle
    ),
    levels = sample_levels
  )]
  libraries[, condition_label := factor(
    fifelse(condition == "control", "Control", "Phage-UV"),
    levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")
  )]
  libraries[, phase := factor(phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))]
  p_libraries <- ggplot(libraries, aes(sample_short)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        xend = sample_short,
        y = retained_library_size_after_filtering / 1e6,
        yend = effective_library_size / 1e6
      ),
      colour = "#AAAAAA",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(y = retained_library_size_after_filtering / 1e6),
      shape = 1,
      colour = "#777777",
      size = 2.1,
      stroke = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        y = effective_library_size / 1e6,
        fill = condition_label,
        shape = phase
      ),
      colour = "#222222",
      size = 2.8,
      stroke = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_values[c("Control", "Phage-UV")], name = "Membrane") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(initial = 21, backflush = 24), labels = c(initial = "Initial", backflush = "Backflush"), name = "Phase") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Library size (millions)", tag = "B") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 38, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "#222222")))

  diagnostics <- fread(paths$diagnostics)[metric %chin% c(
    "trended_dispersion", "tagwise_dispersion", "ql_posterior_variance"
  )]
  diagnostics[, model_label := factor(
    fifelse(model == "main", "Adjusted condition", "Condition x cycle"),
    levels = c("Adjusted condition", "Condition x cycle")
  )]
  diagnostics[, metric_label := factor(
    fifelse(
      metric == "trended_dispersion", "Trended dispersion",
      fifelse(metric == "tagwise_dispersion", "Tagwise dispersion", "QL posterior variance")
    ),
    levels = c("Trended dispersion", "Tagwise dispersion", "QL posterior variance")
  )]
  p_diagnostics <- ggplot(diagnostics, aes(model_label, median, ymin = q25, ymax = q75)) +
    geom_errorbar(width = 0.16, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "#222222", size = 2.8, stroke = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric_label, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Median and interquartile range", tag = "C") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.2) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 18, hjust = 1),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  model_diagnostics <- (p_filter | p_libraries) / p_diagnostics +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.9), widths = c(0.82, 1.35))
  model_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "supplementary-model-diagnostics.pdf")
  ggsave(model_path, model_diagnostics, width = 10.5, height = 7.2, device = grDevices::pdf)
  fwrite(rbindlist(list(
    filter_panel[, .(panel = "filtering", item = as.character(stage), minimum = NA_real_, q25 = NA_real_, median = features, q75 = NA_real_, maximum = NA_real_)],
    diagnostics[, .(panel = "dispersion", item = paste(model_label, metric_label, sep = ": "), minimum, q25, median, q75, maximum)]
  ), fill = TRUE), file.path(staging, "tables", "supplementary_model_diagnostics.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  # Supplementary interaction landscapes.
  interaction <- fread(paths$interaction, select = c("feature_id", "coefficient", "logFC", "logCPM", "FDR"))
  interaction[, coefficient_label := factor(
    coefficient_labels[ifelse(grepl("cycle2", coefficient), "cycle2_interaction", "cycle3_interaction")],
    levels = coefficient_labels[c("cycle2_interaction", "cycle3_interaction")]
  )]
  interaction_counts <- interaction[, .(
    tested_features = .N,
    supported_features = sum(FDR < 0.05),
    supported_abs_logFC_1 = sum(FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 1)
  ), by = .(coefficient, coefficient_label)]

  interaction_plot_data <- rbindlist(lapply(split(interaction, interaction$coefficient), function(x) {
    rbindlist(list(
      deterministic_context(x[FDR >= 0.05])[, display_class := "Context"],
      x[FDR < 0.05][, display_class := "BH FDR < 0.05"]
    ))
  }))

  p_interaction <- ggplot(interaction_plot_data, aes(logCPM, logFC)) +
    geom_point(
      data = interaction_plot_data[display_class == "Context"],
      shape = 1,
      colour = "#A8A8A8",
      size = 0.5,
      stroke = 0.22,
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = interaction_plot_data[display_class == "BH FDR < 0.05"],
      shape = 16,
      colour = "#222222",
      size = 0.75,
      alpha = 0.72
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.35) +
    facet_wrap(~ coefficient_label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    geom_text(
      data = interaction_counts,
      aes(
        x = Inf,
        y = Inf,
        label = sprintf("%s at BH FDR < 0.05", format(supported_features, big.mark = ","))
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05,
      vjust = 1.25,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    labs(x = "Average log2 CPM", y = "Interaction log2 fold-change", tag = "A") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

  omnibus <- fread(paths$omnibus, select = c("feature_id", "logCPM", "FDR"))
  omnibus[, supported := FDR < 0.05]
  omnibus_plot_data <- rbindlist(list(
    deterministic_context(omnibus[supported == FALSE])[, display_class := "Context"],
    omnibus[supported == TRUE][, display_class := "BH FDR < 0.05"]
  ))
  omnibus_count <- omnibus[supported == TRUE, .N]
  p_omnibus <- ggplot(omnibus_plot_data, aes(logCPM, -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)))) +
    geom_point(
      data = omnibus_plot_data[display_class == "Context"],
      shape = 1,
      colour = "#A8A8A8",
      size = 0.5,
      stroke = 0.22,
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = omnibus_plot_data[display_class == "BH FDR < 0.05"],
      shape = 16,
      colour = "#222222",
      size = 0.72,
      alpha = 0.68
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "#777777", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = sprintf("%s at BH FDR < 0.05", format(omnibus_count, big.mark = ",")),
      hjust = 1.05,
      vjust = 1.25,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    labs(x = "Average log2 CPM", y = "-log10(BH FDR)", tag = "B") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

  interaction_figure <- p_interaction / p_omnibus + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.9))
  interaction_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "supplementary-cycle-interaction-landscape.pdf")
  ggsave(interaction_path, interaction_figure, width = 10.5, height = 7.4, device = grDevices::pdf)
  fwrite(rbindlist(list(
    interaction_counts[, .(coefficient = as.character(coefficient), tested_features, supported_features, supported_abs_logFC_1)],
    data.table(
      coefficient = "condition_cycle_omnibus",
      tested_features = nrow(omnibus),
      supported_features = omnibus_count,
      supported_abs_logFC_1 = NA_integer_
    )
  ), fill = TRUE), file.path(staging, "tables", "supplementary_interaction_feature_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  # Supplementary full functional family.
  functional <- fread(paths$functional)
  functional[, signed_log10_fdr := -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin))]
  functional[coefficient != "condition_cycle_omnibus" & Direction == "Down", signed_log10_fdr := -signed_log10_fdr]
  functional[, supported := FDR < 0.05]
  functional[, coefficient_label := factor(coefficient_labels[coefficient], levels = coefficient_labels)]
  functional[, label := factor(label, levels = rev(unique(functional[order(tier, set_id), label])))]
  functional_colours <- phage_uv_signature_colours[functional[, unique(set_id)]]

  p_functional_all <- ggplot(functional, aes(signed_log10_fdr, label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(
      data = functional[supported == FALSE],
      aes(colour = set_id),
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      size = 2.7,
      stroke = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = functional[supported == TRUE],
      aes(fill = set_id, colour = set_id),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3,
      stroke = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = functional[supported == TRUE],
      aes(label = sprintf("FDR = %.2g", FDR)),
      hjust = -0.08,
      size = 2.6,
      colour = "#222222"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ coefficient_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = functional_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = functional_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.24))) +
    labs(
      x = "Signed -log10(BH FDR); omnibus values are non-directional and positive",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5)

  functional_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "supplementary-functional-coefficients.pdf")
  ggsave(functional_path, p_functional_all, width = 10.5, height = 7.7, device = grDevices::pdf)
  fwrite(functional, file.path(staging, "tables", "supplementary_functional_coefficients.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  # Supplementary MAG coherence across the three directional coefficients.
  mag <- fread(paths$mag)[eligible == TRUE]
  mag[, supported := FDR < 0.05]
  mag[, coefficient_label := factor(
    coefficient_labels[coefficient],
    levels = coefficient_labels[c("condition_adjusted", "cycle2_interaction", "cycle3_interaction")]
  )]
  mag_counts <- mag[supported == TRUE, .(MAGs = .N), by = .(coefficient, coefficient_label, Direction)]
  mag_counts[, direction_label := factor(
    fifelse(Direction == "Down", "Down-ranked", "Up-ranked"),
    levels = c("Down-ranked", "Up-ranked")
  )]

  p_mag_counts <- ggplot(mag_counts, aes(coefficient_label, MAGs, fill = direction_label)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.64, colour = "#222222", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = MAGs),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      vjust = -0.35,
      size = 2.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Down-ranked" = "#666666", "Up-ranked" = "#B9B9B9"), name = "Rank direction") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Supported MAGs", tag = "A") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 18, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  p_mag_scatter <- ggplot(mag, aes(median_logFC, -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)))) +
    geom_point(
      data = mag[supported == FALSE],
      shape = 1,
      colour = "#9A9A9A",
      size = 1.15,
      stroke = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = mag[supported == TRUE],
      shape = 16,
      colour = "#222222",
      size = 1.2,
      alpha = 0.72
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#777777", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "#777777", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap(~ coefficient_label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = "Median gene-level log2 fold-change", y = "-log10(BH FDR)", tag = "B") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

  mag_figure <- p_mag_counts / p_mag_scatter + plot_layout(heights = c(0.82, 1.12))
  mag_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "supplementary-mag-coherence.pdf")
  ggsave(mag_path, mag_figure, width = 10.5, height = 7.4, device = grDevices::pdf)
  fwrite(mag_counts, file.path(staging, "tables", "supplementary_mag_coherence_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  # Supplementary five-MAG pairwise landscape.
  all_pair_panels <- rbindlist(lapply(cluster_mag_order, function(mag_id) {
    panel_label <- cluster_labels[MAG_ID == mag_id, panel_label]
    make_pair_matrix(pair_qc, mag_id, panel_label, sample_levels)
  }))
  all_pair_panels[, panel_label := factor(panel_label, levels = panel_levels)]
  p_pair_all <- ggplot(all_pair_panels, aes(sample_x, sample_y)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = consensus_differences_per_mbp), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_tile(data = all_pair_panels[diagonal == TRUE], fill = "white", colour = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel_label, ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#084594"),
      trans = "log10",
      na.value = "#EAEAEA",
      name = "Consensus differences\nper callable Mbp"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 7.2) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.25, "lines")
    )
  population_supp_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "supplementary-population-genomics.pdf")
  ggsave(population_supp_path, p_pair_all, width = 11, height = 8, device = grDevices::pdf)
  fwrite(all_pair_panels, file.path(staging, "tables", "supplementary_population_genomics_cells.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  figure_paths <- c(
    population_main_path,
    model_path,
    interaction_path,
    functional_path,
    mag_path,
    population_supp_path
  )
  if (any(!file.exists(figure_paths)) || any(file.info(figure_paths)$size == 0)) {
    abort("One or more remaining manuscript PDFs were not rendered")
  }

  generated <- list.files(staging, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  generated <- generated[file.info(generated)$isdir %in% FALSE]
  for (source_path in generated) {
    relative <- sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(staging), "/?"), "", normalizePath(source_path))
    promote_file(source_path, file.path(output_dir, relative))
  }

  registry_path <- file.path(output_dir, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv")
  registry <- fread(registry_path)
  additions <- data.table(
    artifact = c(
      "population-genomic-heterogeneity.pdf",
      "supplementary-model-diagnostics.pdf",
      "supplementary-cycle-interaction-landscape.pdf",
      "supplementary-functional-coefficients.pdf",
      "supplementary-mag-coherence.pdf",
      "supplementary-population-genomics.pdf"
    ),
    status = c("candidate_unallocated", rep("supplementary_unallocated", 5)),
    panels = c(
      "strain membership; five-MAG distance summary; Propionicimonas pairwise landscape",
      "feature filtering; library normalization; model dispersion summaries",
      "cycle-2 and cycle-3 interaction landscapes; interaction omnibus",
      "all eight frozen categories across all four predeclared coefficients",
      "supported MAG direction counts and MAG-level coherence across coefficients",
      "coverage-qualified pairwise landscapes for all five scoped MAGs"
    ),
    boundary = c(
      "Selected five-MAG set; coverage-qualified and descriptive only",
      "Model and library diagnostics; not biological effects",
      "Interactions are departures from cycle 1; not standalone treatment effects",
      "Post-model family; SOS transcription is not direct DNA-damage evidence",
      "Condition remains confounded with membrane identity",
      "Selected set; no damage, mutagenesis, adaptation, or treatment inference"
    )
  )
  registry <- rbindlist(list(registry[!artifact %chin% additions$artifact], additions), use.names = TRUE)
  registry_stage <- file.path(staging, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv")
  fwrite(registry, registry_stage, sep = "\t")
  promote_file(registry_stage, registry_path)

  checksum_path <- file.path(output_dir, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  files <- list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, all.files = FALSE)
  files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE & normalizePath(files) != normalizePath(checksum_path)]
  files <- sort(files)
  checksum_table <- data.table(
    path = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(output_dir), "/?"), "", normalizePath(files)),
    bytes = file.info(files)$size,
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))
  )
  checksum_stage <- file.path(staging, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  fwrite(checksum_table, checksum_stage, sep = "\t")
  promote_file(checksum_stage, checksum_path)

  cat(sprintf("Created one remaining main candidate and five supplementary candidates in %s\n", output_dir))
}

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
root <- repo_root()
output_dir <- if (length(args)) args[[1L]] else file.path(
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569",
  "derived",
  "manuscript_figure_candidates"
)
write_remaining_outputs(root, output_dir)
